faq.q: Can I make a YouTube Shorts ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe your product moment and choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: What length can a YouTube Shorts ad be?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A short clip can show one action; a longer clip gives a demo more room to finish.

faq.q: Do I need to book a creator or film anything?
faq.a: No. Start from your own product photo, so there is no creator booking, studio day or footage queue.

faq.q: Does the Short include music or captions?
faq.a: No. Add a soundtrack and caption text in YouTube or an editor after download.

faq.q: Can I run the same file as a TikTok ad?
faq.a: Yes. A 9:16 file fits both feeds, but preview it in each player so controls do not cover the product.

faq.q: What photo should I upload for a Shorts ad?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product and leaves a little space around it for player controls.

faq.q: When do I need a 16:9 video?
faq.a: Use 16:9 for a regular YouTube video or in-stream ad. That is a separate wide job and is not a Shorts format.

faq.q: Can I use the Short in a paid campaign?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Follow Google's current ad-review rules when you publish.
